title: Implement configurable version probing
description:
Make version probing optional with configurable endpoints.

## New Flags
- --probe-version (bool, default: false)
- --version-endpoint (string, default: /api/health)
- --version-timeout (duration, default: 10s)

## Implementation
- pkg/grafana/instance.go
  - Extract version probe to separate function
  - Make it conditional based on --probe-version
  - Support custom endpoints
- pkg/config/config.go
  - Add new config fields

## Behavior
- If --probe-version=false, skip version check entirely
- If --probe-version=true, attempt probe with custom endpoint
- On failure: log warning but continue (don't fail test)

Related: bench-aef
